Author: Sandro
Name: NahjaUI
Punchline: A complete, modular interface for Final Fantasy XIV.
Description:
NahjaUI gives the game a clean, consistent interface that you build piece by piece. Switch on only what you want: everything else stays exactly as the game made it.

HUD bars: your parameter bar, target, target of target, focus target and party list.
Progress bars: your casts and your target's, with a slidecast marker, plus a global cooldown bar that shows the queue and weave windows.
Job gauges, status effects, nameplates and enmity list, each one with its own style.
Trackers: pick the enhancements, enfeeblements and cooldowns you want to see. Every job comes with ready-made presets.
Profiles: save, copy and share your whole setup.

Type /nui to open it.

Join the testers on Discord: https://nahjaui.github.io/discord
Changelog: New: Bard job gauge. The song bar shows the seconds left with a mark where to leave the song (3 s in Minuet and Ballad, 12 s in Paeon) and flashes white on a Mage's Ballad proc; Repertoire only shows in Minuet and Paeon, and Soul Voice has its own bar. New: Windbite / Stormbite and Venomous Bite / Caustic Bite as one row of two progress bars that drain and turn orange with 6 s left; the Archer already sees it. New: Hawk's Eye aura (Bard and Archer), a 30 s timer like Freecure. The Bard DoT, Hawk's Eye and Rotation trackers come switched off by default. New: tracker condition "Only with company" (party member or chocobo); Closed Position uses it, so it no longer nags when you are alone. Fixed: the time to the next charge was wrong for abilities that gain charges with level (Bloodletter at level 42, 2 of 3 charges), and it jumped after a Repertoire proc. Fixed: timer auras (Hawk's Eye, Freecure, Sacred Sight, Verfire, Verstone) no longer turn grey for a moment when a new proc refreshes the status. Fixed: Bard gauge rows no longer leave a gap when a row is hidden, and old Bard DoT layouts are migrated so trackers do not disappear.
